title: Concrete Root-Uptake Producer Readiness and Owner-Gap Resolution
purpose: Determine whether a concrete producer for the qualified F-WOF13 crop-root snapshot and ET-result inputs can now be implemented from qualified SWAP5 owner state/results without reintroducing legacy globals, hidden runtime dependencies, or unqualified crop lifecycle semantics.
fail_closed_rule: No production producer implementation is allowed unless both the crop-root state source and current potential-transpiration source are explicitly owned, source-bound, and available through qualified non-legacy interfaces at the intended root-uptake evaluation point.
required_reads: latest qualified F-WOF crop-owner lineage and its open lifecycle gaps
current production src/crop state-bearing types and interfaces
current ET/potential-transpiration production contracts and result carriers
legacy B1.10 source order for emergence, root distribution, ptra and RootExtraction
allowed_if_ready: a minimal crop-owned view producer over already-qualified crop-root state
a minimal adapter from an already-qualified current ET result to root_uptake_et_result_t
focused deterministic tests and source locks
forbidden: copying legacy crop globals into a new global module
runtime or solver code reading WOFOST/legacy module variables
claiming arbitrary subdaily WOFOST crop evolution
